definition: "A release policy should be maintained as a policy template and outline the required workflow while the software is developed, built, tested, and packaged to ensure the integrity, authentication, and auditability of a software product from initiation to end-user installation. A framework, such as in-toto, can produce meta-data during the build pipeline to enable attestation to the steps in the desired workflow.
